properties.site-address: Suffolk Police HQ, Portal Avenue, Martlesham
properties.notes: Identified as suitable, available and achievable through the Suffolk Coastal Strategic Housing and Economic Land Availability Assessment – dwelling estimates relate to SHELAA. Proposed allocation (SCLP12.25) in Suffolk Coastal Final Draft Local Plan (Jan 2019). Full site is part brownfield/part greeenfield. 140 dwellings based on 5.37ha previously developed land (based on SHELAA dwellings estimate).
